bonus.name: Magic of the Spider Queen
bonus.text: The drider casts Darkness , Faerie Fire , or Web , requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

traits.name: Air Form
traits.text: The stalker can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.text: The stalker has the Invisible condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

actions.name: Wind Swipe
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Vortex
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker’s space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can’t cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker’s turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Detect Magic , Light , Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand , Prestidigitation 2/Day Each: Fireball (level 4 version), Invisibility 1/Day Each: Cone of Cold , Fly

bonus.name: Misty Step
bonus.text: The mage casts Misty Step , using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.text: The mage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mammoth makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the mammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

bonus.name: Trample
bonus.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Petrifying Gaze
bonus.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Captain’s Charm
bonus.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate’s next turn.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.text: Trigger: The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the vrock dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The vrock has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vrock makes two Shred attacks.

actions.name: Shred
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Spores
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While Poisoned, the target takes 5 (1d10) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Emptying a flask of Holy Water on the target ends the effect early.

actions.name: Stunning Screech
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock (demons succeed automatically). Failure: 10 (3d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the vrock’s next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The wyvern makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the wyvern’s next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Sleep Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 38 (11d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Sleep Breath
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.text: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 40 (9d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ape makes two Fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder Toss
actions.text: The ape hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 90 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

bonus.name: Leap
bonus.text: The ape jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni’s next turn.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): 1/Day Each: Charm Person (level 2 version), Darkness , Gaseous Form , Sleep

bonus.name: Invisibility
bonus.text: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

name: Shield Guardian
languages: Understands commands given in any language

traits.name: Bound
traits.text: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet’s wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet’s wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.text: A spellcaster who wears the guardian’s amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster’s spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

reactions.name: Protection
reactions.text: Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian’s amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian’s next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.text: Trigger: The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. Response: The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack’s force. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 49 (14d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slowing Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 40 (9d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Slowing Breath
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target can’t take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can’t use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The assassin makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Light Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the assassin’s next turn.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
bonus.text: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

actions.name: Chain
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Conjure Infernal Chain
actions.text: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil’s next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. Success: The chain disappears.

reactions.name: Unnerving Gaze
reactions.text: Trigger: A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. Response—Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, the triggering creature. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. Success: The target is immune to this devil’s Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: While in Bright Light, the cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.

actions.name: Attach
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can’t make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Moan
bonus.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the cloaker. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the cloaker’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this cloaker’s Moan for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus.text: The cloaker casts the Mirror Image spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Frost Axe or Great Bow in any combination.

actions.name: Frost Axe
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: War Cry
bonus.text: The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant’s next turn.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hezrou. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hezrou makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Leap
bonus.text: The hezrou jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.text: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.text: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Detect Magic , Mage Hand , Minor Illusion , Water Breathing 2/Day Each: Detect Thoughts , Dimension Door , Hold Person (level 3 version), Lightning Bolt (level 4 version)

actions.text: The tyrannosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 15 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
